description.from: The public API that feels obvious: botspy.sessions(source=...), iterating sessions then messages then parts, filters by kind/time/project, JSON and JSONL export, and a botspy CLI. Lazy and streaming; read-only end to end.
description.to: The public query API: botspy.sessions(source=None), iterating sessions then messages then parts, with filters by kind, time, and project. Lazy and streaming; read-only. Specs first: features/query/*.feature is the source of truth; implementation is generated from the specs.
